purpose: Reads, creates and patches the employment entities of a person's record, one t:Employment per employment.
namedChanges: `GEO_ORIGIN` (a module constant of the source's geo client) is the optional argument `catalogueOrigin` of `resolveEmployments` and `employmentFromDoc`; with none a compact place reads as none (`fullAddressOnly`, new).

`updateEmploymentEntity`: a null only for a value the person removed. `a:jobTitle` is nulled only when `facts.titlesStored` held a non-blank title and the edit left none (the source nulled it whenever no title was left). The role is not in the shared wire; it is `roleChangeWire(facts.roleBefore, facts.role, attrs)` (the source cleared every attribute the form held empty). New optional fields `titlesStored` and `roleBefore` of `EmploymentFacts`.
`readEmploymentEntity` (lines 424-451) and `employmentEdgesToWire` (358-373) are not taken: only the source's tests called them.
The file's header comment is new and shorter.
